{{Quote|He was married for twenty of those years to a woman of the Newcomers, a jeweler, who died in a landspeeder accident.|Mayor [[Snaplaunce]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>}}
[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Cagaran Wei]] was, for twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]], [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to a '''woman''' of the [[Newcomer]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. A jeweler, Cagaran Wei's wife bore him a [[Cagaran Wei's son|son]], but later [[Death/Legends|died]] in a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] accident.
